commands.name: list-checks
commands.summary: List your monitoring checks with alias, target URL, status and check interval. Optionally search and sort.

commands.name: add-check
commands.summary: Create a new monitoring check (HTTPS by default) with a target URL, check period and alias. Returns the updated checks list.

commands.name: get-check
commands.summary: Show a check's detail page: alias, latest result, next scheduled check, yearly SLA and downtime summary.

commands.name: get-check-settings
commands.summary: Read a check's editable settings (alias, enabled flag, string match, period, form action). The target URL is in list-checks.

commands.name: update-check
commands.summary: Update an existing check's URL, type, alias, check period, apdex, string match or enabled state.

commands.name: list-status-pages
commands.summary: List your public status pages with their name, public URL, visibility info and edit link.

commands.name: list-downtimes
commands.summary: Show the downtimes page for your checks (optionally filtered by check token).
